name: Joska
description: A moon with violet seas where Reen's squad destroyed a Palatinate lander of three hundred colonists, the atrocity that ended the negotiated peace.

description_citations.work: Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero
description_citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero" by Rich Larson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: In memory, Reen recalls Joska and the Palatinate lander that her squad targeted.
timeline.quote: If she keeps her eyes shut, she sees, inevitably, the target: a Palatinate lander bobbing just offshore.

timeline.summary: Too Much Happiness connects Reen's tattoos to the Joska atrocity that ended the peace.
